_help.tiers.small.grow: Moments set to "small" make a piece swell this far past full size, then settle (0.07 = 7% bigger). Higher = a bigger bounce. Try 0.05–0.15.
_help.tiers.small.shake: Only the "no" shake uses this, when it is set to small. Higher = a wider sideways shake (0.07 = 7% of the piece's width). Try 0.05–0.12.
_help.tiers.medium.grow: Moments set to "medium" make a piece swell this far past full size, then settle (0.3 = 30% bigger). Higher = a bigger bounce. Try 0.2–0.4.
_help.tiers.medium.shake: Only the "no" shake uses this, when it is set to medium. Higher = a wider sideways shake. Try 0.08–0.15.
_help.tiers.big.grow: Moments set to "big" make a piece swell this far past full size, then settle (0.5 = 50% bigger). Higher = a bigger bounce. Try 0.4–0.7.
_help.tiers.big.shake: Only the "no" shake uses this, when it is set to big. Higher = a wider sideways shake. Try 0.1–0.2.
_help.events.seedPop: Which juice size each "+1" / "+2" pops in with — bigger = a bouncier pop. To change it, type small, medium or big in the file (feel.json).
_help.events.totalPop: Which juice size the turn's total pops in with — bigger = a bouncier pop. To change it, type small, medium or big in the file (feel.json).
_help.events.turnPulse: Which juice size the current player's glyphlings breathe with at the start of a turn — bigger = a bigger swell. To change it, type small, medium or big in the file (feel.json).
_help.events.noShake: Which juice size the "no" shake uses when you tap something you can't move — bigger = a wider shake. To change it, type small, medium or big in the file (feel.json).
_help.events.refreshGrow: Which juice size a new seed swells with as it grows into the tray after a Refresh — bigger = a bigger swell. To change it, type small, medium or big in the file (feel.json).
